Package com.aigccompliance

Class ComplianceClient

java.lang.Object
com.aigccompliance.ComplianceClient
public class ComplianceClient extends Object
AIGC Compliance Java Client Official Java client for AIGC Compliance API. Provides comprehensive AI content detection and watermarking capabilities.
Version:
1.0.0 Example usage: 
 ComplianceClient client = new ComplianceClient("your-api-key");
 ComplianceOptions options = ComplianceOptions.builder()
     .region("US")
     .watermarkText("AI Generated")
     .watermarkPosition("bottom-right")
     .includeBase64(true)
     .build();
 ComplianceResponse response = client.comply("path/to/image.jpg", options);
Author:
AIGC Compliance Team

    • comply

      public Map<String,Object> comply(@NotNull @NotNull String filePath, @NotNull @NotNull String region, @Nullable @Nullable String watermarkPosition, @Nullable @Nullable String logoFile, boolean includeBase64, boolean saveToDisk) throws IOException, com.aigccompliance.ComplianceAPIException
      Process image for AI content detection and compliance watermarking
      Parameters:
      filePath - Path to the image file to process
      region - Region for processing ("EU" or "CN")
      watermarkPosition - Position for watermark ("top-left", "top-right", "bottom-left", "bottom-right")
      logoFile - Optional path to logo file to include
      includeBase64 - Whether to include base64 encoded image in response
      saveToDisk - Whether to save the processed image to disk
      Returns:
      Map containing the compliance response
      Throws:
      com.aigccompliance.ComplianceAPIException - On API errors
      IOException - On file reading errors
